breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly includes the torsional shear stress τ at the outer surface (τ = T * c / J) and uses it in the plane stress state (τxy = τ) for computing principal stresses. It does NOT instruct the torsional shear stress to vanish at the outer surface, which was the error in the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth, which also includes both bending normal stress and torsional shear stress in the combined stress state analysis.
